 EPAM Romania
 EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer to join our team as a key operational and hands-on contributor, delivering Group Risk tenancy for Post Trade as part of the data platform strategy execution across all areas of the business.
 We’re launching a Double Referral Bonus Campaign for this role in EPAM Romania open positions, covering candidates referred and hired between September 7th, 2026 and December 31st, 2026. The campaign applies to A3+ roles, for both B2B and permanent positions, across all skills and technologies.
 Responsibilities
Act as a member of the program and work with product teams to design and implement modern, scalable data solutions using a range of new and emerging technologies
Contribute to innovation in the data space
Develop and support the AWS & Snowflake based cloud data platform
Support and migrate data from legacy platforms
Play a key part in the roll-out of a new cloud-based data platform
Design and develop automated data pipelines and data structures
Build automated testing to test data pipelines
 Requirements
5+ years of experience with Python programming
5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience for data warehouse solutions using Snowflake or any DB, SQL
2+ years of hands-on experience using CI/CD pipelines on GitLab
2+ years of experience working with Agile Delivery teams (Scrum, Kanban) and JIRA
Understanding of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies and software development best practices
Background in ITIL processes within a 2nd/3rd line support environment
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
